verses.1: And God called out to Moses, and He spoke to him from the tent of meeting.
verses.2: I speak to the children of Israel, and I say to them: Man should offer his sacrifices to God from whatever animal he has: from sheep, from cattle, and from pigs. They should offer their own sacrifices.
verses.3: If it happens that our sacrifice is offered from morning till evening, then we shall bring it before the door of the sanctuary. It will be presented to Jehovah’s desire.
verses.4: And he laid his hand on the head of the ladder, and I wanted to put it on top of him.
verses.5: And they sacrificed the son of the morning before Jehovah. Then the priests, the sons of Aaron, offered the blood, and they sprinkled it on the altar around the entrance to the temple.
verses.6: And he peeled off the top, and then he applied it to its place.
verses.7: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, offered fire on the altar. They also cut down trees to use as fuel for the fire.
verses.8: And the sons of Aaron measured the lengths of the branches and the thicknesses of the wood that was used for the altar.
verses.9: And his feet and knees would be washed in the water. Then the priest would burn all the offerings on the altar. An aroma of peace was offered to Yahweh.
verses.10: And if from the sheep, we sacrifice it from the goats or from the wild animals; then a pure and holy animal shall be offered as a sacrifice.
verses.11: And they slaughtered him on the altar, in front of Jehovah. Then the sons of Aaron, the priests, threw his blood on the altar around it.
verses.12: And he cut it down, along with its branches and roots. The priest measured them according to the measurements required for the wood that would be used in making the altar.
verses.13: And the offerings and sacrifices will be washed away in the water. Then the priest will offer all these things, and he will burn the incense on it. It is a fragrant aroma for the LORD.
verses.14: And if from the flock, we offer our sacrifices to Jehovah. And if from the lambs or from the children of the flock, we also offer our sacrifices.
verses.15: And the priest brought it before the altar. He cut off its head, and then he burned the animal. Its blood was poured out onto the wall of the altar.
verses.16: And he removed its appearance with his nails, and then he threw it beside the altar, in front of the place where the ashes were placed.
verses.17: And he carried him in his wings, without any distinction. Then the priest who performed the sacrifice set him on the trees that stood over the fire. It was a sweet scent to Jehovah.
